prompt:
Create a high-fidelity OmniGear KEYBOARD 'Iluminação' UI design comparison. Use attached approved Teclas screen as STRICT visual identity and keyboard reference: same OmniGear header, sidebar, neutral black/white palette, clean sans typography, realistic matte black compact keyboard. REPLACE remapping content with lighting controls. Remove selected Caps Lock outline, connection leader, and remap popup. Square board with TWO full equal desktop landscape screens stacked vertically: DARK above and LIGHT below, identical control state and physical keyboard. Crisp readable Brazilian Portuguese.
Header 'OmniGear' + small 'Demonstração' badge. ONE moon outline icon upper-right in dark, ONE sun outline icon upper-right in light. No theme switch or paired icons. Sidebar20%: '← Dispositivos', 'Teclado de demonstração', 'Perfil 1' dropdown, ONLY 'Teclas','Iluminação' SELECTED,'Perfis','Geral'.
Main heading 'Iluminação', subtitle 'Escolha o efeito, a cor e a intensidade.'
Lighting DEMO state: effect 'Estático' selected; available effect choices 'Estático', 'Respiração', 'Onda', 'Desligado'. Uniform white keyboard backlighting at70% across ALL keys, restrained realistic light in key gaps and legends, no white haze beyond keyboard. Black keycaps remain black. Identical physical keyboard in both themes. This is GLOBAL lighting, no per-key selection or layers.
Controls: 'Efeito', 'Cor' with white selected swatch and editable hex field '#FFFFFF', row of six small circular color swatches white/red/green/cyan/blue/purple (functional color choices only, no palette decoration elsewhere). Selected white swatch has contrasting ring. Brightness 'Intensidade' horizontal slider, thumb70% track, readable '70%' value. 'Velocidade' slider disabled in selected static effect with concise helper 'Disponível em efeitos animados.' No fake live device status or hardware claims. Label near keyboard 'Prévia simulada'. Colors only inside functional swatches and keyboard selected light (white); rest interface monochrome.
Main bottom footer '1 alteração não salva', secondary 'Descartar', primary 'Salvar no perfil'. White primary dark, black primary light. No macros, Hall settings, synchronization between devices, calibration, cloud, duplicate apply buttons or theme settings inside lighting panel. Match reference spacious functional UI.
OPTION1: Main body split68% keyboard canvas LEFT,32% fixed form inspector RIGHT separated by fine vertical rule. Large keyboard fully visible and centered left; small Prévia simulada text below. RIGHT controls stacked in this order: Efeito dropdown Estático; Cor hex field + six swatches; Intensidade70% slider; Velocidade disabled slider+helper. Dropdown is closed but nearby subtle secondary text 'Estático · Respiração · Onda · Desligado' can show available scope if space; no need to duplicate effects into buttons. No nested cards or popovers. Use enough vertical gaps, full keyboard fits without cropping. Footer beneath both.
title: Prévia com painel lateral
description: Teclado amplo à esquerda e controles de iluminação à direita.
notes: Global keyboard lighting design. Preview is simulated, with static white at70%. Show only supported effects, color and speed capabilities. Speed disabled for static; color and brightness disabled when lighting off. Keyboard geometry and legends must match actual model in implementation.
